column7: admin restore --overwrite-existing installed the archive key files before loading the data: a load that then failed (PostgreSQL: duplicate key over a populated database; either backend: the mandatory dangling-reference check) left the archive keys beside the live rows (SQLite: beside an empty database), so secrets written after a DEK rotation no longer decrypted (UPGRADE-ROLLBACK-1 bug 1). Keys are now staged, the data committed first (PostgreSQL: one transaction that also empties the target; SQLite: a staged database file), and both installed under a restore journal. Red on main ecd5ce7c1 for both backends (live dek.key replaced). Kill points: TestAdminRestore_Overwrite_KillPoints.
